Statement section - Send the State machine to Maestro "Emulating" openTCS states
// "Control_DB".WMS_OPC_UA.SM_State_Maestro; // State to send Devices to Maestro
// "Control_DB".WMS_OPC_UA.SM_State_Maestro := 1;//RAW conidtion => Maestro will write this condition
ELSIF "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Data_Available AND NOT "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Movement_Ready AND "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".SM_State_Maestro = 1 THEN
"Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".SM_State_Maestro := 2;//QUEUED condition =>ANY device (Conveyor, VTD OR Shuttle)
// Any Device RUNNING on the system (VTD - Conveyor Transfer - Shuttle Transfer)
OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 1 OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 2 OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 3)
AND "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Movement_Ready AND NOT "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Movement_Request_Complete THEN
// Any Device DONE on the system (VTD - Coneveyor Transfer - Shuttle Transfer)
OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 1 OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 2 OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 3)
// Any Device ERRORS on the system (VTD - Coneveyor Transfer - Shuttle Transfer)
OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 1 OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 2 OR "Control_DB"."VTD_Order Table".Task_Type = 3)
"Control_DB".WMS_OPC_UA.SM_State_Maestro; // State to send Devices to Maestro
"Control_DB".WMS_OPC_UA.SM_State_Maestro := 1;//RAW conidtion => Maestro will write this condition
